# REST API for a Multi-User Application

Build a structured JSON API with authentication and reliable data access.

## Setup
Install a supported PHP 8.5.x runtime. Add Composer only when required by the milestones. Copy the configuration example, supply local-only credentials via environment variables, and never commit secrets.

## Status
Starter outline only; complete the milestones and acceptance criteria before considering this project finished.
